dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with a sharp recurvature rising from a broad base to a tapered apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a minimal pixel radius, forming a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 vertical height to maximum base width ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile convex arc on the anterior-dorsal boundary with high curvature transitioning to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust pixel length with a thickness-to-length ratio of approximately 1:1.5.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharply elongated and pointed caudal flukes with a prominent ventral fluke notch and low-polygon geometric surface artifacts.
